title: Hypothalamus-Pituitary-Thyroid Axis
text: This is a three-level control system. The hypothalamus controls the pituitary, which controls the thyroid. But the thyroid's output (thyroxine) feeds back to both higher levels.

title: Hormone Receptors
text: Both the hypothalamus and anterior pituitary have receptors for thyroxine. When thyroxine binds these receptors, it signals that enough hormone is present in the blood.
